verdict.rationale: Role-based permissions are a fair question for a project-management tool like Shortcut, but the evidence pack never documents roles or granular view/edit permissions. The closest items, creating separate Workspaces to protect sensitive information and Docs suggestion mode, are adjacent features or workarounds rather than granular role assignment, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can assign granular permissions and roles to control who can view or edit work
